description: A function handed a CONTAINER is refused at COMPILE time, in a view as in a query: the sentence names the function and its argument types anchored at the CALL's place in the WHOLE statement (view bodies composing their re-parsed offsets with where the body starts, multi-line bodies keeping their own column, aggregates anchoring through the GROUP BY path too), AVG reports as SUM (live names the function the plan rewrites into), the refused view is never created empty, and the legal uses (GET, TYPEOF, TO_VARCHAR) stay legal. Converted 1:1 from expressions/SemiStructuredArgumentRefusalTest (now retired).
